Title: Phase II Results for a Paediatric Asthma Inhaler
Audience: hospital formulary committee and paediatric pulmonologists
Objective: secure formulary inclusion ahead of the winter season
Tone: cautious and evidence-led
Language: English
Slides: 14
Topics: trial design and endpoints, efficacy versus standard of care, adverse event profile, subgroup analysis by age band, limitations and open questions, formulary request
